notes.title: Oculus Quest 1 & 2 Support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37827016/446cee940ab77a711ce287e986a6b9ce84932873.png[/img]

Great news for Oculus Quest 1 and 2 owners! Update with native support for Link-mode for these headsets is already live.

Our regular players are also not left behind. This update also improves image sharpness and text readability. It also contains optimisations for levels with large numbers of droid infantry units.

And, of course, as promised - 25% discount to celebrate the update (from May 1st, 10:00 AM PST)!

notes.title: Oculus Quest support coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37827016/90d8561f4b5999c5920aef31c7931550d42201f8.png[/img][h1]Greetings, community! [/h1]

We noticed that more and more people prefer comfortable VR headsets Oculus Quest 1 and Oculus Quest 2. And even got a few ourselves ;)

We are happy to announce an upcoming update with full support of Link mode for these wonderful headsets.

Subscribe and wishlist the game to be able to buy it at a discount to celebrate the new update!
